selection_policy.after_possible_billing: Preserve the attempt, reconcile its charge, then request a separately bounded retry; never automatic fallback POST.
selection_policy.before_generation: Use existing selector and only current task-accepted compatible routes; preserve quality, family, effort and complete inputs.
selection_policy.new_models: Terra, Kimi and new gateway/model versions remain scoped candidates until their actual task evidence is accepted.
selection_policy.normal_review: Read existing receipts and free catalog/quote observations; no extra model judge or recurring paid probe.

dynamic_decision.reason: approved baseline; no unverified route is tried

gateway_meter_before.currency_rule: owner-approved numeric USD wallet unit equals CNY1; not market FX

discovery_policy: At most twelve new literature search operations use native defaults. Dataset query/catalog operations keep their separate native defaults; all are metadata leads. Model calls are counted separately. Additional paid helpers are outside this bounded validation.
scope: One native G1 candidate-development cycle; actual findings alone justify repair and fresh re-review. No topic selection, gate approval, advancement, automatic rescheduling or new budget.
